Strong and effective defence

The Circosta Law Firm provides strong and effective defence in criminal law, representing individuals and companies in investigations, trials and appeals.

We handle cases ranging:

  • from economic and corporate crimes;
  • to offences against persons and property.

We ensure precise strategies and full protection of procedural rights.

From the earliest stages of investigation

Our Firm supports clients from the very first stages of investigation, offering legal assistance during questioning, precautionary measures and interactions with the authorities.

International criminal law and cyber crime

We also defend in highly complex cases involving international criminal law and cyber crime, ensuring that modern forms of criminal liability are addressed with competence.

Beside our clients in court

Our strength lies in litigation: we stand beside our clients in court, committed to defending their freedom, reputation and rights with professionalism and determination.
